rdfs:label: oidcIssuer
rdfs:comment: The OpenID Connect issuer (OP) a WebID trusts to issue ID tokens for it; Solid-OIDC resource servers check the token's iss against this value in the WebID profile.
notes: The Solid-OIDC trust anchor, required by Solid-OIDC on any WebID (people, bots, services, organisations): the value is the issuer URL of the OpenID Provider whose tokens this WebID will accept. A WebID may list multiple `oidcIssuer` values for redundancy. Distinct from the older FOAF `urn:solid:openid` (an OpenID 1.x/2.0 identifier, unrelated to Solid-OIDC).
